children: Reform UK has removed crypto firms from its conference sponsor list ahead of its annual meeting in Birmingham next week, while promoting diplomats and manufacturers instead. The party has not announced any policy change on digital assets, according to BeInCrypto, and the shift appears focused on sponsors and perks rather than its stance on crypto.
Separately, Avon and Somerset Police recovered 20.21 BTC, other crypto and cash worth £1,032,487.86 from funds tied to darknet marketplaces operating from 2016 to 2019.

title: Reform UK Drops Crypto Sponsors Before Birmingham Conference
